economic_hypothesis: A broad correction initially makes a relative leader only a liquidity outlet. Demand is actionable only if the source-day low survives and, within 15 completed sessions, market breadth and the stock industry recover together while the stock closes for the first time above the correction-day high. This converts temporary resistance into a completed repricing auction.
entry: first legal daily open after trigger within three market sessions
failure_exit: after T+1, first completed close below frozen source-day high (failed breakout); exit next legal open

four_binding_conditions.CAUSAL_SOURCE: exact frozen V35 broad-correction relative-leader source; source itself is not traded
four_binding_conditions.FIRST_RECOVERY_BREAKOUT: within 15 sessions, first qualifying completed close above source-day high; trigger return 0% to +8%; close location >=60%
four_binding_conditions.MARKET_AND_INDUSTRY_RECOVER: trigger-day eligible-universe median return >0, positive share >=55%, and PIT-industry median return >0
four_binding_conditions.SOURCE_STRUCTURE_SURVIVES: no completed close below the correction-day low and no coordinate-lineage change before trigger
